{{Top|leg}}
A '''megawatt''' was a unit of measurement with regards to power. The [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder's]] oversized twin [[Turbofan/Legends|turbofan]] [[Seventh-stage bank-courier repulsor-truck engine|engines]] were capable of producing 30 megawatts of power.
